title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry: Discounts, Rewards and Credit Counted per Registry
content:
When a customer holds several registries of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry, each registry keeps its own figures: completion discounts and the completion discount cap, registry rewards together with the rewards minimum and cap, and registry credit are each counted per registry and never pooled across registries.

## What follows from counting per registry

- **Completion purchase.** A completion purchase uses the completion discount of the registry the item is on.
- **Registry credit.** Registry credit from one registry may be spent on any purchase, but it is drawn only from that registry's own balance.
- **Guest gifts.** A guest gift counts only for the registry it is linked to.
- **An item on two registries.** When the same item is on two registries of the same customer, it is completed under one of them, chosen by the registrant at the purchase.

## Questions this rule answers

**Can the completion discounts used on one registry reduce the cap still open on another?**
No. Each registry's cap is measured only against that registry's own completion discounts.

**Do guest purchases from two registries add up toward one rewards minimum?**
No. The rewards minimum and the rewards cap are tested registry by registry, on the gifts linked to each.

**Can credit from a registry pay for an item that is not on that registry?**
Yes; registry credit from a registry may be spent on any purchase, but only from that registry's own balance.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A customer holds a Wedding Registry with USD 40.00 of registry credit and a Housewarming Registry with USD 25.00. A purchase can draw up to USD 40.00 from the Wedding Registry's balance or up to USD 25.00 from the Housewarming Registry's balance; the two balances are never combined into one balance of USD 65.00.
